policy: Reviews are keyed to verified source SHA-256. Product-description evidence does not authorize visual model input; exact byte-pinned media must pass direct visual leakage review, and any sanitized derivative requires a separate exact-hash review. The three custom architecture cases are evaluated only through approved raw or exact reviewed sanitized inputs.

notes: Exact verified manufacturer image shows the complete MidFig ball-jointed upper-body architecture.
Titanic Bricks logo and text are visibly present in the lower-left background and must be removed before evaluation use.
The logo region is spatially separated from the figure, so a deterministic background-fill mask can preserve the full architecture.
Exact verified product image cleanly shows the single-torso four-arm architecture on a neutral background.
No visible maker logo, product text, SKU, inset panel, secondary figure, or other shortcut cue is present.
Exact byte-pinned 301x500 product zoom image was materialized through the review-only CI path after SHA-256 and dimension verification.
Clean isolated full-body pose on a neutral gradient background; no visible maker text, logo, product label, SKU, inset panel, or secondary figure is present.
Ball-jointed shoulders, elbows/arms, hips/legs, feet and neck architecture are visibly represented well enough for the intended custom-architecture evaluation.
